messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: METRICS ALERT - token_count_delta high for customer=acme-inc in prod-us-west-2. overage_flag=true, delta=+42000 vs baseline 12000. Pager: @pagerduty

pagerduty: Paging oncall-alice (priority P1) — see incident details: https://incidents.redwood.example/5887654321

oncall-alice: Acked. I'm on it. Quick check — is this global or a customer-specific emitter issue?

maria-billing: seeing a surge in downstream overage flags for multiple tenants, but only Acme shows token delta spike in the raw emitter stream. Logs show repeated replays from emitter-id=em-7a

kevin-sre: running quick query on aggregator: `select sum(tokens) from token_emits where minute between now()-10m and now()` returns a bump starting at 2026-11-02T15:42:00Z. attaching snippet:
```
2026-11-02T15:41:00Z total=12345
2026-11-02T15:42:00Z total=54213
2026-11-02T15:43:00Z total=55900
```

raj-platform: sounds like emitter replay loop. Recent deploy to emitter service at 15:40 — rolling back to previous version could stop duplicates. Oncall, do you want me to revert?

oncall-alice: yes please revert if safe. Maria, can we temporarily silence billing alerting for affected tenants to avoid customer emails?

maria-billing: I can mute the overage webhooks for flagged accounts for 30m. doing that now for customer=acme-inc and a few adjacent accounts. will keep audit note. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Mute action recorded: billing-webhooks:acme-inc muted by maria-billing for 30m (reason: suspected duplicate emitter replay).

raj-platform: starting rollback of emitter service to v2.1.3 -> v2.1.2. Command: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/emitter-service --to-revision=2`

kevin-sre: while rollback proceeds, please also disable aggregator replays: set consumer group commit mode to 'at-most-once' for topic token-emits-temp to prevent reprocessing historical backlog. command queued:
```
kafka-consumer-cli --topic token-emits-temp --group agg-consumer --commit-mode at-most-once
```

oncall-alice: rollback complete? status?

raj-platform: rollback finished on all replicas in us-west-2. instance rollout id=c2f3. Watching metrics now.

kevin-sre: aggregator rate dropping. delta smoothing — new query:
```
2026-11-02T15:46:00Z total=13200
2026-11-02T15:47:00Z total=12890
2026-11-02T15:48:00Z total=12780
```
Looks back to baseline.

maria-billing: overage flags cleared for acme-inc, undoing mute in 25m if all good. I'm preparing a short customer note template in case they got an email.

emma-support: Acme reported an automated overage email at 15:44. I told them we're investigating and will follow up. Can we send them a corrective note?

oncall-alice: yes please send corrective note after we confirm counts are back and decide whether to credit. Keep me in loop.

kevin-sre: ongoing — looks like two failure modes: emitter deployed with idempotency flag off + a consumer restart that reprocessed a small backlog. Mitigations applied: rollback emitter + set commit-mode. Recommend postmortem to add safety check to deploy pipeline to ensure idempotency header present.

raj-platform: I've created a short runbook entry and added a quick health check to CI that asserts `X-Idempotency` header is present for emitter requests. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/emitters/pull/412

maria-billing: for billing reconciliation: we'll run backfill dedupe job to remove duplicated token rows for the affected window (15:40-15:48). ETA ~ 40m. Will coordinate with accounting.

ops-bot: Backfill job scheduled: dedupe-tokens-window(5887654120-5887654480) by maria-billing. Estimated runtime 35-50m.

oncall-alice: thanks all. handoff to kevin for overnight watch. I'm stepping off in 10. Keep thread updated if anything reoccurs.

kevin-sre: taking watch. I'll monitor the emit stream and billing counters; paging thresholds lowered for next 30m to catch recurrence.

emma-support: I'll send the corrective customer email draft once Maria confirms final counts. Keeping support ticket open #SUP-1138.

maria-billing: backfill finished. dedupe removed 41,872 duplicated token rows for acme-inc. Running final reconciliation now, pushing adjustments to billing ledger.

kevin-sre: no recurrence in last 30m. Metrics stable. closing immediate incident but leaving follow-up tasks: deploy pipeline check, postmortem, billing credits review.

oncall-alice: closing my oncall shift. Thanks everyone. :wave:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - token counting anomaly mitigated. Root cause: emitter deploy removed idempotency header + consumer replay. Follow-up: postmortem assigned to raj-platform and maria-billing.
